annotations.title: Coinbase Premium (US demand gauge) + carry yield

description: Call this when the user asks whether US investors are buying or selling Bitcoin or Ethereum, about the Coinbase Premium, or what the cash-and-carry basis trade pays. Returns the latest daily premium in percent, 7-day average, same-sign streak, the last 30 days, and annualized quarterly carry yields. History since 2017; positive premium = US buying pressure. The kimchi and Turkey premium daily rows cover the last 7 days; pass days (up to 90) for more.

days.description: Optional. Days of kimchi and Turkey premium daily rows, newest first (default 7, up to 90).
